say:1:1120616001:0.text: Be careful. There's something lurking in the sand... A creature of some sort. It came out and attacked us.
say:1:1120616001:0.source_cn: 小心，沙子里有什么东西……某种动物。我们被咬伤了。

say:3:1120616002:0.text: It's a lair for desert scorpions!

choice_prompt:4:1120616002.text: It's a lair for desert scorpions!

say:6:1120616003:0.text: The sting doesn't hurt. In fact... I don't feel anything at all. Does that mean we're okay?
say:6:1120616003:0.source_cn: 伤口一点也不痛，不如说是……毫无感觉。这是不是说明没什么事？

say:7:1120616004:0.text: No, it doesn't! Desert scorpions have extremely powerful neurotoxins that can cause paralysis and even heart failure...
say:7:1120616004:0.source_cn: 沙漠毒蝎的毒性很强！毒液进入血液，会让肢体麻痹，最严重...

say:8:1120616005:0.text: What?! Hurry up, Oldiler, we have to cut our wounds open and squeeze out the venom!
say:8:1120616005:0.source_cn: 什么？！欧迪尔，快把伤口划破，把毒液挤出来！

say:9:1120616006:0.text: ... It's no good, I can't feel my hands anymore.

choice_prompt:10:1120616006.text: ... It's no good, I can't feel my hands anymore.
